name: Images & Video
original_description: Create images and short videos from text in your Abracadabrax workspace. Prepare a project in the conversation, choose a supported model, aspect ratio and video length, then review the settings before requesting generation. Check an existing job and retrieve its completed output in chat or open the saved project on Abracadabrax. Generation requires a connected Abracadabrax account with available credits and sends the supplied prompt to the selected model provider. Uploaded or reference media, editing, upscaling and social publishing are not supported by this app. Results are AI-generated.
summary_ja: 文章から画像・短い動画を生成してジョブを確認する。
limitations_ja: 接続済みアカウントとクレジットが必要。プロンプトは選択したモデルの提供元に送信される。アップロード・参照メディア、編集、拡大、SNS公開は非対応。
